title.original: Jet-RL: Enabling On-Policy FP8 Reinforcement Learning with Unified Training and Rollout Precision Flow
title.zh: Jet-RL：以统一训练与轨迹精度流实现同策略 FP8 强化学习
title.en: Jet-RL: Enabling On-Policy FP8 Reinforcement Learning with Unified Training and Rollout Precision Flow

inclusion_reason.zh: Jet-RL 提供训练与 rollout 统一的 FP8 精度流及权重传递规则，可复用于低精度同策略 RL 系统。
inclusion_reason.en: Jet-RL provides a unified FP8 precision flow and weight-transfer rules across training and rollout, reusable in low-precision on-policy RL systems.

abstract.zh: Jet-RL 让训练和 rollout 统一使用 FP8，消除常见 BF16 训练、FP8 推理之间的数值策略偏差，以稳定长时程同策略强化学习。
abstract.en: Jet-RL uses a unified FP8 path for both training and rollout, removing numerical policy mismatch introduced by the common BF16-training and FP8-inference split.

problem.zh: 仅量化 rollout 虽节省大量生成计算，却使执行策略与训练策略数值不一致，在长轨迹和困难任务上可能造成不稳定甚至精度崩溃。
problem.en: Quantizing only rollout saves generation compute but makes the behavior policy numerically inconsistent with the training policy, causing instability or collapse on long trajectories and difficult tasks.

approach.zh: 作者系统分析混合精度失效来源，并将前向、参数更新和生成统一到 FP8 精度流，避免额外的跨阶段校准。
approach.en: The authors analyze the mixed-precision failure mode and unify forward execution, updates, and generation under one FP8 precision flow, avoiding cross-stage calibration.

system_design.zh: 训练器和生成引擎共享一致的 FP8 表示与量化规则，权重在两阶段直接流转；精度管理层控制缩放和更新，使 rollout 保持同策略。
system_design.en: Trainer and generation engine share FP8 representations and quantization rules, weights flow directly between stages, and precision management controls scaling and updates to preserve on-policy behavior.

key_results.zh: 在所测任务中，统一 FP8 同时加速 rollout 与训练并保持稳定收敛，避免分裂精度方案出现的明显退化。
key_results.en: Across the evaluated tasks, unified FP8 accelerates both rollout and training while preserving stable convergence and avoiding the degradation of split-precision pipelines.

limitations.zh: 结果取决于支持 FP8 的硬件和内核，低精度对其他优化器、模型结构和奖励尺度的稳健性仍需更广泛验证。
limitations.en: Results depend on FP8-capable hardware and kernels, and robustness across other optimizers, architectures, and reward scales requires broader validation.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
